== Introduction == <!--T:1-->

<!--T:6-->
This tutorial explains how to create center hole lines using the [[Image:Workbench_TechDraw.svg|24px|link=TechDraw_Workbench]] [[TechDraw Workbench]] with oriented holes.

<!--T:2-->
By creating angles for holes it's not possible to use vertical or horizontal center lines (false/true) from the properties of the view. Helping lines and/or helping points are created for this necessity.

== Proceeding == <!--T:3-->

<!--T:4-->
1. Setting center lines on holes:

<!--T:5-->
There are some possibilities to create a center line for holes. 
At first the lines or points on the hole must be selected as shown below. Second, the following tools can be used from the toolbar to create the center line: 

<!--T:7-->
: [[File:TechDraw 2PointCenterLine.svg|24px]] [[TechDraw_2PointCenterLine|Add Centerline between 2 Points]]
: [[File:TechDraw 2LineCenterLine.svg|24px]] [[TechDraw_2LineCenterLine|Add Centerline between 2 Lines]] 
<br>

</translate>
[[Image:TechDraw_Tutorial_2PointCenterLine_example.png|250px|]]
<translate><!--T:9-->
{{Caption|Above: created with [[File:TechDraw 2PointCenterLine.svg|16px]] which creates centerlines between 2 points}}
</translate>

[[Image:TechDraw_Tutorial_2LineCenterLine_example.png|250px|]]
<translate><!--T:10-->
{{Caption|Above: created with [[File:TechDraw 2LineCenterLine.svg|16px]] which creates centerlines between 2 lines}}
</translate>

<translate><!--T:12-->
In the associated Combo View dialog box select in the Tasks panel under ''Orientation'' "Aligned" for axes out of main axes. ''Extend By'' means the length of the center line beyond of the body line in the drawing. With ''Shift Horizontal'' and ''Shift Vertical'' the center line can move in horizontal or vertical direction, if is necessary. ''Style'' means the figure of center line. 

</translate>
[[Image:Create-Center-Line3P.JPG|250px|left]]

<!--T:34-->
The created center line can change. Select the center line and press the button [[File:TechDraw 2LineCenterLine.svg|24px]] or [[File:TechDraw 2PointCenterLine.svg|24px]] from the tool bar which you have created the center line. Delete the center line only with [[File:TechDraw_CosmeticEraser.svg|24px]] from the tool bar after selecting the center line.
<br>
<br>

<!--T:35-->
2. Setting angles:

<!--T:36-->
Quadrant points select with [[File:TechDraw_Quadrants.svg|24px]] from the tool bar. Next select the points as show below and use [[Image:TechDraw_Dimension_Angle3Pt.svg|24px]] from the tool bar to create the angle. Other succession create other angles.
Is there no catching point on the center line change "ISO count" in the properties.

</translate>
